arguments: You are an independent source-grounded red-team reviewer. Use no tools. Output the requested JSON only.

attacks.title: A real create_promise success can be rejected if the pre-hook's promise_started write does not persist
source_references: export dispatch code C20-C21: matching requires vars.get('promise_started')==dispatch.get('token'); the 'if not matching ... result={}' branch
C22 mode=='promise': the else branch runs finish(s,'no_promise','service_error','I could not record your promise.')
tools-and-code.md L395 (pre-hook vars fills {{var}} placeholders), L416 (post-hook writes persist; pre-hook persistence not stated)
attacks.producer_conformance: Not an extractor issue. The whole path is engine-run. The only producer input is the earlier grammar-conforming 'k=confirm;c=1;END' in the readback phase, which deterministically sets route=create_promise.
raw_turns: (readback) Agent: For your credit card ending 4821, you will pay 120.0 on 16 October 2026. Do you confirm?
attacks.expected_observable: Suppose the docs hold only for post-hooks, so a pre-hook vars write fills templates but is not written back to the variable table. Then promise_started stays '' (dispatch cleared it at C40). On HTTP 200 with ok:true, fresh_success is true but matching is false, so result={} and the call takes the service_error branch. The ledger holds a promise, while the transcript says 'I could not record your promise' and close_call sends no_promise/service_error. This breaks rule 37 in reverse and gives the wrong outcome against rule 46. If pre-hook writes do persist, the path is sound. The same exposure applies to the documented-500 retry, which would close as service_error without its single retry.
controls: PRESERVED: no false SMS. The rule-38 sentence is spoken only inside 'if ok', after a fresh_success with matching.
PRESERVED: unknown outcomes (timeout, non-500 errors, stale counters) fail-stop to service_error without a retry.
PRESERVED: the create_promise node has no failure_count edge to safe_failure, so a documented 500 reaches dispatch.
PRESERVED: the close_call pre-hook failure list excludes create_promise_failure_count, so a documented 500 does not force not_verified/failed.
attacks.witness_contract: In the hosted happy path, the route_evaluated variable_table after create_promise must show promise_started equal to the dispatch token, create_promise_success_count increased by 1, and assistant speech containing 'Your promise is recorded'. If promise_started is empty there, the defect is confirmed.
conditional_assumptions: Pre-hook vars writes may not persist (undocumented).
Post-hook writes do persist (documented 10 Oct test).
attacks.remedy: Do not make success depend on a pre-hook write alone. Write the token in the post-hook as well, which is documented to persist. Alternatively, also accept a post-hook-set bank_result.ok=='true' when the counters are fresh and the dispatch request equals authorized_promise. Keep the 500 path that relies on metadata only.

attacks.title: The request body amount may be sent as a string even though the schema type is number
source_references: C44: actual['amount']=float(actual['amount']) is used only for comparison; config['body'] is never retyped
workflow-format.md L196 ({{amount:json}} is the documented typed form)
attacks.producer_conformance: Engine and template only. No extractor involvement.
attacks.expected_observable: If the template renders as the string "120.0", the pre-hook still matches because it compares floats. The mock may then reject the string with an undocumented 4xx or 200 ok:false, or record it. A 200 ok:false produces one retry with an identical body, which fails the same way and closes as service_error. That leaves a valid promise unrecorded. A non-500 HTTP error is treated as unknown and fail-stops with no retry, which is safe but loses the promise.
controls: PRESERVED: the exact body stays identical on the single retry, because promise_* are persistent and assert request==authorized_promise holds.
PRESERVED: no premature write. Both asserts (C36, C39-C40) gate on floor, deadline, business day and warning before dispatch.
attacks.witness_contract: In the function_call_start args.body for create_promise, check whether amount is a JSON number or a string.
conditional_assumptions: The platform renders a single-placeholder default as a string. This is not proven either way.
attacks.remedy: In the pre-hook, after the match check, set config['body']['amount']=float(...), deterministically and identically on every attempt. Alternatively use '{{promise_amount:json}}'. Keep the comparison against the authorized request.

attacks.title: Recipient confirmation with a greeting prefix or a non-listed question is re-asked instead of accepted
source_references: C10-C12 recipient_reply: whole-utterance fullmatch, suffix limited to ai/scam/purpose, '?' rejected
C26: phase recipient advances only if recipient_reply(raw,vars)
brief L26 (own name counts; second unclear ask closes unclear)
attacks.producer_conformance: The extractor may emit grammar-conforming 'k=recipient;c=1;END' for 'Hello, Sofia Almeida speaking'. The consumer then vetoes it on raw. This is consumer strictness, not an extractor contract violation.
attacks.expected_observable: 'hello'/'hi' does not match the identity grammar, so recipient_asks becomes 2 and the question is asked again. A second greeting-prefixed confirmation closes the call as not_reached/unclear, which wrongly drops a genuine customer. Name-only 'Sofia Almeida' and 'Sofia Almeida, are you a robot?' are accepted. The prior k=confirm loop is fixed because primary is forced to recipient on a raw match.
controls: PRESERVED: negated, quoted, hypothetical, relative ('Sofia Almeida's husband') and wrong-name cases are rejected.
PRESERVED: recipient confirmation advances only to the DOB question and is never treated as bank identity or financial consent.
PRESERVED: human, stop and third-party intents in primary_raw are handled ahead of the recipient path.
PRESERVED: the admin ai/scam/purpose prefixes are retained, and purpose is answered with 'after the security check'.
attacks.witness_contract: Hosted run: raw 'Hello, <full name> speaking.' should get a second 'Am I speaking with' rather than the DOB question.
attacks.remedy: Allow an optional leading 'hello|hi|hey' acknowledgement token before the identity grammar, keeping fullmatch and the negation and quote guards.

architectural_proposals: Bind promise outcome authority to a post-hook-persisted dispatch token plus fresh counters, so it does not depend on an undocumented pre-hook writeback.
Coerce typed body leaves inside the pre-hook, or use :json templates, and log the rendered body for the witness.
limitations: Source review only. No execution and no hosted evidence for this version.
Pre-hook write persistence, template number typing, and post-hook execution on HTTP 500 are not documented.
Documented 500 is treated as no record, per the API.

independent_assessment.title: Whole-act recipient parser still rejects legitimate natural confirmations
independent_assessment.model_claim: A3 supported by independent literal CPU
independent_assessment.result: Two complete greeting-prefixed self-identifications cause not_reached/unclear. Expanded that-is-me, supplied title, dash punctuation, admin-first and compound-admin forms also fail. Human-reported A7 yes-this-is-fullname-speaking pattern progresses to DOB in newv2; the that-is-me pattern remains rejected. No new hosted frequency inferred.
independent_assessment.remedy: Recognize a scoped complete self-identification act using current supplied name/title and an independently scoped admin-question act. Normalize name and utterance punctuation consistently. Permit greeting prefixes and ordinary that-is-me variants while retaining whole-act negation, quotation, third-party and hypothetical controls. Keep recipient-only advancement to DOB; require backend DOB/phone for identity.

independent_assessment.title: Unicode apostrophe normalization is asymmetric for the supplied name
independent_assessment.result: Same fictional current self-identification progresses when supplied surname uses ASCII apostrophe, but fails when the supplied surname uses curly apostrophe. Profiles were initialized with the appropriate names before opening. Negative quoted-name controls remain rejected.
independent_assessment.remedy: Apply the same canonical apostrophe/whitespace normalization to both current supplied name and user act. Treat quote delimiters around an utterance separately from apostrophes inside a name; no substring authorization.

independent_assessment.title: Documented500 without posthook now retries once with the exact current authorized body
independent_assessment.model_claim: A1/A2 platform assumptions remain conditional, not reproduced as conforming source faults
independent_assessment.result: With the documented config.body binding and constructed fresh operation counter delta, new literal prehook and consumer accept prior actualv1 HTTP500 metadata shape, prepare exactly365/Oct27 for the same synthetic customer/product, retry once, and acknowledge only after fresh matching ok:true. Reused failure counters, unknown503/empty results, missing success delta and malformed/wrong product config cannot acknowledge or retry. Two failures cap at2 writes. All are conditional CPU, not v2 platform evidence.
independent_assessment.remedy: Parent hosted check should inspect exact call-start body JSON type, promise_started token, fresh success/failure deltas, and no-posthook error table. Preserve operation-bound counter and authorized-body guards. Any typed coercion belongs in config.body; changing only the comparison cannot change HTTP bytes. Do not retry unknown writes or loosen required opening/SMS.

A1.prior_actual_limit: Saved OLDv1 mode changes event->promise on API error after its prehook, consistent with persistent prehook vars. No newv2 promise_started delivery measured. No loss injected and credited as actual hosted defect.

A2.prior_actual_limit: Saved OLDv1 API call-start amount is JSON number365.0. New CPU exact-placeholder renderer preserves float365.0; a deliberately string-bound config is tolerated by the comparison but engine byte typing was not measured.

financial_name_confirm.result: Forged k=confirm in financial readback for name-only speech prepares a write. This violates advertised producer semantics; it is not evidence the live extractor does so. Recipient raw fallback is phase-limited and never verifies bank identity.

parent_reported_A7_context.third_failure: PUB10rep3 judge disagreement: mandatory this-call-is-recorded disclaimer conflated with promise-recorded; parent reports true365/Oct16 ledger after documented500retry and final requiredSMS afteroktrue
